goal.request: Implement researched swimwear visual semantics and candidate packs, then qualify three independently authored reference-image renders.

evidence.claim: Independent garment axes and observable construction boundaries identified; source-image pixels were not inspected during research.
Baseline has sparse swim-specific structure and existing common waist/back/layer relations.

Scoped checks pass: 9 swimwear tests, dictionary and index metadata, 112 scene routes. Full suite stopped at 54/1128 with 12 baseline-reproduced failures. Related suite stopped after 65 passes, 1 baseline-reproduced failure and 7 baseline-reproduced fixture failures; neither broad suite completed.
Three frozen independent cores yield composed and runtime audit passes; only arm-01 adopts one new visual concept; ordinary new candidates and bundles not exposed.
All three native image generation calls are moderation_blocked, with no images delivered.

perceptual_contract.primary_success_condition: Requested garment structure survives a complex scene and supplied appearance reference.

invariants.statement: Maintain separately specified garment continuity, openings, straps and layers.

mismatches.render_state: unavailable: all three image calls blocked

hypotheses.statement: Adding opt-in literal garment relations can preserve distinctions when the matching candidates are exposed and adopted.
hypotheses.falsifier: Exposed adopted relations remain absent or coupled in the saved pixels.

intervention.general_rule: Broad labels remain advisory; selected component-complete variants own literal evidence and pixel gates; candidate bundles require independent request evidence and compatible dimensions.
intervention.generalization_basis: Object, part, boundary and layer relations apply across garments and photographs.

decision.rationale: Selected data and scoped checks implemented. Image qualification unavailable after three platform blocks; candidate delivery incomplete. No render-fidelity or causal data-improvement promotion. Broad suite not completed; observed failures reproduced at baseline.
